    Support Us

    Marylebone

    The Bomb Factory Art Foundation is a charitable arts organisation that transforms vacant buildings across London into vibrant cultural hubs. Over the last decade, we have provided affordable studios for artists, presented exhibitions that challenge the status quo, and run free public programmes that make art accessible to the communities we serve.

    Upcoming

    GYRE - Nika Neelova at The Bomb Factory Holborn

    We are pleased to present Gyre, a solo exhibition by Nika Neelova. Working primarily with reclaimed architectural remnants and found objects, Neelova transforms materials marked by time, revealing traces of the people and places they once belonged to. The exhibition explores the histories held within objects and the ways materials preserve and transmit knowledge across time. Through sculpture, Neelova considers what remains when an object is removed from its original context
    SCULPTURE

    OPEN STUDIOS - Bomb Factory Archway

    Our next Open Studios event will be held in Archway, offering visitors the opportunity to meet resident artists and explore works in progress across the site. Open Studios provide a chance to step inside artists’ working environments, learn more about their practices, and engage directly with the community that shapes The Bomb Factory Art Foundation. Studios will be open from 12–6pm. LOCATION: Unit 2 Boothby Road, N19 4AJ DATE: Saturday 26th September TIMES: 12-6pm Photo: Mar
